the eight loci identified in this study are the major loci that control seed isoflavones and can be used to isolate genes underlying seed isoflavonoid content and quality.

soybean seed isoflavones are quantitatively inherited, and that the isoflavone QTL are located in 8 genomic regions.
the genetic control of seed isoflavones is complex and the loci controlling seed isoflavonoid content are distributed throughout the soybean genome.

isoflavone amounts in soybean seeds are under genetic control and that genetic improvement of isoflavonoids in soybeans is possible.
